✅Filming Rules
  • Bare skin. No filter, no makeup, no smoothing.
  • Same spot, light, distance and time of day.
  • Before / 7 days after on screen.
  • Name the spot. Never just "my skin."
  • Hands in frame for all three steps.
  • ~45 seconds. Say "available on YesStyle"; link in bio.
  • No medical or brand comparisons. Never name Botox, fillers or another brand.
